summary: Iteration 61 - Guest Payment Portal feature testing complete. All 17 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all components working correctly.

issues: Clipboard write permission error when clicking Pay Link button (non-critical - browser security restriction in test environment)

seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data - Sarah Johnson booking for Aldgate Flats
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest Payment Portal feature fully tested. All endpoints working: send-link, folio, pay, status, links, add-charge. Guest Payment Page at /pay/{token} shows hotel name, booking details, itemized charges by category, balance due, and Pay Now button that redirects to Stripe Checkout. Admin UI: Pay Link buttons visible on confirmed bookings with pending payment in Bookings tab. Guest Links tab in Payment Gateway shows all sent links with status and Copy Link button (requires selecting specific property from branch dropdown).

backend_apis: POST /api/guest-payment/send-link - Admin sends payment link (creates PaymentLink in DB, returns URL with token) ✓
GET /api/guest-payment/folio/{token} - Public: Returns full folio with hotel info, booking details, itemized charges by category, payments made, balance due ✓
POST /api/guest-payment/pay/{token} - Public: Creates Stripe checkout session for balance, returns checkout.stripe.com URL ✓
GET /api/guest-payment/status/{token} - Public: Returns payment link status (pending/paid/expired) ✓
GET /api/guest-payment/links/{property_id} - Admin: Lists all payment links for a property ✓
POST /api/guest-payment/add-charge/{link_id} - Admin: Adds extra charge to a payment link ✓
frontend_pages: /pay/{token} - Guest Payment Page shows hotel name, guest folio card, itemized charges grouped by category, balance due, Pay Now button ✓
Pay Now button redirects to checkout.stripe.com with correct amount ✓
Expired/invalid token shows error message 'Link Unavailable' ✓
Bookings panel shows Pay Link button on confirmed bookings with pending payment ✓
Payment Gateway Guest Links tab shows sent links with status and Copy Link button ✓

stripe_integration.notes: Stripe checkout sessions created successfully with test key sk_test_emergent. Redirects to checkout.stripe.com sandbox mode.
